title: SmartResume AI: Automated ATS Feedback & Keyword Gap Analyzer
tagline: Turn PDF resumes into structured interview readiness scores with Gemini 1.5/2.5 Flash
summary: Builds a web tool where a student uploads their resume PDF and a target job description; the AI performs gap analysis, identifies missing skills, and rewrites weak bullet points into impactful STAR-format achievements.
resumeBullet: Engineered an ATS resume optimization engine using Google Gemini API and Streamlit; extracted semantic discrepancies against JD keywords, boosting candidate match relevancy by 40%.

title: GitHub Repo AI Inspector: Instant Code Explanation & Bug Spotter
tagline: Paste any public GitHub URL and get an interactive AI walkthrough of the codebase
summary: Fetches repository README and top source files via GitHub API, passes them through a structured prompt pipeline, and generates architectural diagrams, component breakdowns, and detected edge cases.
resumeBullet: Developed a lightweight browser-based codebase analyzer leveraging GitHub API and LLM prompt chaining to produce instant system architecture summaries and potential edge-case bug alerts.

title: Exam Proctor AI: Real-time Eye Gaze & Multiple-Face Alert Bot
tagline: Webcam-based classroom integrity assistant running fully in the browser
summary: Tracks student head pose, gaze direction, and face count directly on client-side webcam feed to flag suspicious off-screen glances without sending heavy video feeds to the cloud.
resumeBullet: Built client-side browser proctoring system using MediaPipe FaceMesh to classify gaze deviation angles and multi-person presence in under 45ms per frame.

title: Microgrid Pulse: Predictive Battery Health & Solar Yield Forecaster
tagline: Forecast solar battery degradation and storage efficiency using synthetic sensor telemetry
summary: Simulates voltage, temperature, and charging cycle curves from IoT nodes; uses regression and AI-assisted anomaly detection to predict battery remaining useful life (RUL).
resumeBullet: Created predictive maintenance IoT dashboard modeling solar inverter sensor feeds; predicted battery degradation anomalies with 88% precision to prevent unscheduled outages.

title: SiliconDoc AI: Automated Circuit Diagram & Datasheet Q&A Bot
tagline: Upload 80-page microcontroller datasheets (STM32, ESP32) and query pinouts in plain English
summary: Multimodal assistant that ingests complex semiconductor datasheets, pinout charts, and schematic screenshots to answer hardware design queries and calculate resistor divider values instantly.
resumeBullet: Architected multimodal hardware documentation query bot utilizing Gemini Vision to extract microchip pin configurations and calculate passive component values directly from schematics.

title: WeldVision: AI-Powered Industrial Surface Defect Detector
tagline: Classify porosity, cracks, and undercut defects in metal joints from mobile photos
summary: Uses transfer learning on pre-trained vision models to inspect manufacturing weld seams, assigning a pass/fail confidence score and generating a quality inspection report.
resumeBullet: Trained and deployed a computer vision quality control pipeline categorizing weld seam defects (porosity, cracks) with 91% accuracy, eliminating manual visual inspection bottlenecks.

title: BuildCode AI: Indian Standard (IS 456) Structural Compliance Auditor
tagline: Prompt assistant that verifies beam dimensions and concrete grades against Indian Building Codes
summary: Input structural parameters (span, load, grade of concrete); the AI references IS 456 clauses and flags whether the minimum reinforcement percentage and deflection criteria are satisfied.
resumeBullet: Created an interactive IS-Code structural compliance validator powered by Gemini API, accelerating preliminary RCC beam verification and code citation lookups.

title: JobScout AI: Autonomous Placement Lead Scraper & Tailored Email Drafter
tagline: Watches target tech hiring boards and auto-generates personalized cold outreach emails
summary: Scrapes tech hiring feeds for graduate roles, parses technical requirements, compares them with the student's profile, and drafts bespoke recruiter messages tailored to the company's culture.
resumeBullet: Engineered autonomous job reconnaissance agent combining web scraping and LLM prompt templates to synthesize customized hiring manager outreach with an 85% relevance score.
